name: Resist Temptation
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 2, paladin 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V, S, DF

eEFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 10 min./level

DESCRIPTION

Your resolve hardens, giving you a +4 bonus on Will saves against charms, enchantments, or spell-like effects that are attitude-affecting (such as charm person, bardic song, or a harpy’s captivating song), as well as against Diplomacy checks that serve to change one’s attitude.
